if [ -f /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom ]; then
  /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom set_wlan '5' '6' 'US'
else
  cat > '/etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/wifi-0.nmconnection' <<'NMEOF'
[connection]
id=5
type=wifi
autoconnect-priority=0
[wifi]
mode=infrastructure
ssid=5
[wifi-security]
auth-alg=open
key-mgmt=wpa-psk
psk=6
[ipv4]
method=auto
[ipv6]
method=auto
NMEOF
  chmod 600 '/etc/NetworkManager/system-connections/wifi-0.nmconnection'
fi

if [ -f /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom ]; then
  /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom set_timezone 'Etc/UTC'
else
  rm -f /etc/localtime
  echo 'Etc/UTC' >/etc/timezone
  dpkg-reconfigure -f noninteractive tzdata
fi

if [ -f /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom ]; then
  /usr/lib/raspberrypi-sys-mods/imager_custom set_keymap 'fr' 'fr'
fi

rm -f /boot/firmware/firstrun.sh
sed -i 's| systemd.run.*||g' /boot/firmware/cmdline.txt
exit 0
